idea: Reduce the counted bud population by making selected buds jump over other pieces on a white-tile board with movable rail platforms. The player clicks a bud and then a highlighted legal landing cell to jump, while direction actions move every yellow platform one rail cell when legal. Green-over-green jumps remove the jumped bud, purple posts are permanent jump hurdles, red buds can reposition without consuming greens, and blue buds are useful non-counted pieces. Levels should teach basic jump elimination, platforms as moving bridges, multiple platforms moving together, fixed and riding posts, reusable red movement, non-counted blue setup pieces, and final rail puzzles where preserving future jump opportunities matters more than greedy elimination.
title: Leap Frog
